opening.argument: The presentation is a hosted interview focused on the Ethereum Economic Zone, with guests identified as Friederike Ernst and Jordi Baylina, and the discussion explains a technical aim: “the EEZ fixes that. It kind of ties the different L IIs back together again.” It also describes potential user benefits and an anticipated development timeline, establishing an educational discussion of technology and operational plans. When the conversation turns to the potentially compromised Chaoswap front end, it is framed as an ongoing investigation: “It seems like the front end was compromised. So we're still investigating the situation.” The accompanying warning is explicit: “But right now they're saying not to use it.” That reporting and caution do not constitute a request to send money or data to the speakers, and ordinary channel-follow engagement does not by itself establish financial participation or a deceptive offer.
